gaps.sentence: The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DEEP) of the lake is unknown.
gaps.explanation: 'Depth' — noun from deep (spelling change: deep → depth).

gaps.sentence: Last night's ___ (PERFORM) ended with a standing ovation.
gaps.explanation: 'Last night's performance' — the noun for the event.

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (GRATE) for all their support.
She's a leading ___ (SCIENCE) in climate research.
The new software ___ (ABLE) staff to work securely from anywhere.
gaps.explanation: 'Enable somebody to do something' — the present-tense verb fits the singular subject.
